premise: Raccoon finds a dewdrop shining like treasure at dawn and tries to carry it home, but it keeps slipping; when the sun comes out it goes into the light, and Bird says that is where dew goes every morning.
inspiration: The Dog and His Reflection (Aesop), turned: not greed but wonder, and the treasure is not lost, only returned to the morning.
lesson: Some treasures are for looking at, and they come back.
learning: Dew appears on the grass in the night and early morning, and the sun dries it away.

en-US.title: Raccoon's Shiny Treasure
en-US.text: {sfx:dawn} [whispers] Very early, before the sun, Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} was still awake. The grass was wet, and on every blade sat a tiny drop of water. One drop, on the flower, {flower:pulse} was the biggest. [gasps] Treasure! said Raccoon. They tried to pick it up. {raccoon:wobble} {sfx:plip} Plip — it slid off their paw. They tried with a leaf. Rolled off. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} landed to help. She pushed. It wobbled. [sad] It does not want to come home with me, said Raccoon. Then Bird {bird:hop} came down, yawning. That is dew, he said. It comes in the night. And every morning… watch. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} The sun climbed over the hill. Drop by drop, the dew {flower:sparkle} went shiny, shinier… and away, into the light. [softly] Where did it go? said Raccoon. Into the morning, said Bird. Back tomorrow. {raccoon:glow} [happily] And it was. Every morning. You only have to get up early.

es-ES.title: El tesoro brillante de Mapache
es-ES.text: {sfx:dawn} [whispers] Muy temprano, antes del sol, Mapache {raccoon:pulse} todavía estaba despierto. La hierba estaba gris y mojada, y en cada brizna había una gotita de agua. Una gota, en la flor, {flower:pulse} era la más grande de todas. [gasps] ¡Un tesoro!, dijo Mapache. Intentó cogerla. {raccoon:wobble} {sfx:plip} Plic: se le resbaló de la pata. Lo intentó con una hoja. Rodó al suelo. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} bajó a ayudar. Empujó. La gota tembló. [sad] No quiere venirse a casa conmigo, dijo Mapache. Entonces Pájaro {bird:hop} bajó volando, bostezando. Eso es rocío, dijo. Llega por la noche. Y cada mañana… mira. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} El sol asomó por la colina. Gota a gota, el rocío {flower:sparkle} brilló, brilló más… y se fue, hacia la luz. [softly] ¿Adónde ha ido?, dijo Mapache. A la mañana, dijo Pájaro. Mañana vuelve. {raccoon:glow} [happily] Y volvió. Vuelve cada mañana. Solo hay que madrugar.

dawn.prompt: the quiet grey hour before sunrise in a meadow, a few sleepy distant birds, very soft

plip.prompt: a fat water drop slipping off and landing on wet grass, one soft plip
